Looking at history: Resident3 contributed 0 in round7? Actually round7 my contribution 35.47, Resident3 0. Round8 Resident3 127.31 (>10). So not two consecutive. Resident1 0 in round8 and 0 in round9? Round8 Resident1 0, round9 Resident1 20 (>=10). So none. So no punish. Also can praise high contributors >=60% of wallet. Our wallet 35.96, 60% =21.576. Who contributed >= that? Resident4 contributed 60 (>=21.6). Resident6 contributed 0. Resident2 10 (<21). So we can private_message Resident4 praising.
